description: Run a Google search and get structured SERP results — organic results, titles, links, snippets, and related data. Example: scraperapi_google_search({ query: "best running shoes 2026", country_code: "us", tld: "com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

country_code.description: Two-letter country code for geotargeting the search, e.g. "us". Optional.

query.description: The Google search query, e.g. "best running shoes 2026"

tld.description: Google top-level domain, e.g. "com", "co.uk". Optional (default com).

name: scraperapi_google_search
title: Scraperapi Google Search
